## Purpose

The weekly two-year long-run build already runs `snowy_land_pmodel.jl` with both prescribed MODIS LAI and prognostic optimal LAI (`ZhouOptimalLAIModel`, #1794). The weekly 19-year build (`LONGER_RUN`, `ILAMB_RUN`) only runs prescribed LAI. This PR adds a prognostic-LAI step to the "Longer runs of Global Land Models" group of `.buildkite/longruns_gpu/pipeline.yml`.

## Content

- New step `:seedling: Snowy Land (Optimal LAI), 19 years`: the same script with `LONGER_RUN=""` and `PROGNOSTIC_LAI=""`, 1 GPU, 15 h limit. It uploads PNGs from `snowy_land_pmodel_opt_lai_longrun_gpu/`.
- Runtime: in build 5123, the prescribed 19-year run took 7 h 08 min. The two-year optimal-LAI run takes 52–60 min against 51–53 min for prescribed (builds 5110 and 5126). That suggests about 8 h for the new step, well within the limit.
- ILAMB is unchanged. The ILAMB group still depends only on `snowy_land_19yr_run` and reads the prescribed run's diagnostics. Its `wait` is scoped to the group, so the new step does not delay or block the leaderboard. The new run also writes `ILAMB_diagnostics` in its own output directory, but they are not uploaded to the dashboard.
- Based on main after #1901, so this run also produces the vegetation leaderboard. MODIS LAI covers 2000–2020, so the 2000–2019 run is within range.

## Validation

- Not run yet: this needs a manual build of `climaland-long-runs` on this branch with `LONGER_RUN=""`. That build also starts the prescribed 19-year and 20-year soil runs.
- The pipeline YAML parses, and the new step has the expected env and agents.
